turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I'm sorry you feel this way. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over from here. Threats can't be accepted, but a person will look at your problem. If you can, please send your order number and the email on the order, so they can help faster.
